# Golden cases whose Go output differs from the C reference by design.
# Format: <dataset> | <options> | <deviation id>; TestGolden checks each
# against the oracle and the expected shape of the difference:
#   B1  -At item map bug: C crashes or prints wrong items
#   B3  generators with -m >= 2: C misses generators (C output is a
#       proper subsequence of Go's)
#   B4  maximal sets that consist of top-level perfect extensions only
#       (also M9: -x with the 16-items machine): C misses the set
#   B5  closed/maximal with -n: C reports non-closed/non-maximal sets
#       (Go output is a proper subsequence of C's)

b1a.tab | -tc -At -s20 | B1
b1a.tab | -ts -At -s20 | B1
b1b.tab | -ts -At -m2 -q1 -s10 | B1
b3.tab | -tg -Ac -l0 -s-1 -m2 | B3
b3.tab | -tg -Ac -s-1 -m2 | B3

b3.tab | -tg -Ad -s-1 -m2 | B3
b3.tab | -tg -As -l0 -s-1 -m2 | B3
b3.tab | -tg -As -s-1 -m2 | B3
b3.tab | -tg -At -s-1 -m2 | B1
